cards.name: Arcane Bolt
cards.description: Deal [b]%s[/b] damage to target [b]enemy[/b]
cards.validation_status: Native Godot CardPileView page 1 reviewed; shared hand/inspection/reward contexts passed
cards.visual_concept: Create ONE finished original Arcane Bolt card illustration, landscape 3:2. The three attached images are EXPLICIT STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, never pasted or reused as layers. Image 1 Riftwalker: preserve precisely its slightly oversized hooded head, smooth tapered ivory mask, two long dark almond eye openings, teal cowl and layered tunic, brown gloves, gold clasp and leather belts. Images 2 and 3 enemies: match their clean thick dark contours, big simplified expressive shapes, few carefully chosen cel-shaded shadow planes and restrained painterly transitions. Use the purple armored six-legged Horror from image 2 as target, reillustrated in a recoiling pose. Composition: dynamic three-quarter over-shoulder Riftwalker at left extending a gloved hand; a SINGLE concentrated cyan magic bolt flies toward the Horror at right across a broken low stone walkway. Original action scene, integrated hand-drawn curled energy at the fingertips, tapered luminous bolt with only a couple broad accent strokes. Background is secondary atmospheric slate-blue shapes: two simple broken arches and a few mist bands. Broad intentional color blocks; only a handful of large stone slabs, no masonry microtexture. Camera close enough that both characters are large and legible. Character proportions and costume match references; clean contour rhythm carries the forms. Drama through pose and compositional diagonals, NOT realism. Match the rendering simplicity of the references exactly: no photorealism, no cinematic concept-art treatment, no fine hatching, no granular texture, no detailed faraway cities, no dense tiny particles or debris, no realistic volumetric lighting. Hand-size clarity at 148x99. No writing, card frame, watermark, symbols or UI overlays. Full original illustration with NEW character poses and perspective; do not composite existing sprites.
cards.production_method: built-in image_gen, reference-guided original illustration; full-frame downscale only
